question: Can original relative-order R1 still produce a physical answer after new P/Q source acquisition, actual-consequence comparison and later data use without R1 reteaching?
mechanism_family: Same declared physical reader renewed at fixed finite cadences; no edits, no phase resets, no hidden recreation.
criterion: Input applied, active semantic1 record at original emission port three ticks later, direction(s,-1,0) with s=+/-1; original body relation and all component states reported separately. Historical sign is evaluator-only, never supplied to decoder.
resource_comparison: body_only and integrated share the same basal body and experiences; integrated adds documented controller/source material and inputs, not equal-resource comparison.
